mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.product_id, o.created_at, o.note, o.quantity, p.name AS product_name, p.price, p.thumbnail_url FROM customer_orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC
